title: Booking an evening course

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: You will hear a man phoning an arts centre to book a place on an evening course. First, you have some time to look at questions 1 to 6.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions 1 to 6.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Good afternoon, Kestrel Bay Arts Centre, Jenny speaking. How can I help?

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: Oh, hello. I'm ringing about your evening courses. I'd like to book a place for the autumn term, if there's still space.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Of course. Let me just open the booking form. Can I take your name first?

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: Yes, it's Martin Browne. That's Browne with an E on the end, so B, R, O, W, N, E.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Thank you, Mr Browne. And which course are you interested in?

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: Well, I did look at life drawing, but I think I'd rather make something I can actually use at home. So, pottery, please. I've never done it before.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: That's fine, the pottery course is designed for complete beginners. We run two groups, one on Tuesday evenings and one on Thursday evenings, both from seven till nine.

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: Tuesday would be best for me, because I often work late on Thursdays.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Let me just check. Oh dear, I'm afraid the Tuesday group filled up this morning. There are still a few places on Thursday, though.

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: Ah, that's a shame. Well, I'm sure I can sort something out with my manager. Put me down for Thursday, then.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Lovely. The course runs for ten weeks. The fee is seventy pounds, and there's a separate charge of fifteen pounds for the clay and glazes.

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: So that's eighty-five pounds altogether?

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: That's right, eighty-five pounds in total. You can pay online or here at reception.

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: Great. Do I need to bring any tools or anything?

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: No, we supply all the tools, and there are aprons in the studio. The only thing you need to bring is a small towel, because your hands get very muddy.

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: Good to know. And one last thing, is there anywhere to park?

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Our own car park is closed for repairs until December, unfortunately. Don't use the one opposite the library, because that charges all evening. The best place is the car park behind the swimming pool. It's free after six o'clock.

script.speaker: Martin
script.text: Behind the swimming pool, right. Thanks very much for your help.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: You're welcome, Mr Browne. We'll see you in October.

instruction: Complete the form below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

context.title: Kestrel Bay Arts Centre: Evening Course Booking
lines: Parking: use the car park behind the [[6]]

questions.evidence: B, R, O, W, N, E
questions.explain: Nama keluarga dieja huruf per huruf: B, R, O, W, N, E. Martin menegaskan ada huruf E di akhir ("with an E on the end"), jadi "Brown" tanpa E salah. Di Part 1, nama yang dieja hampir selalu jadi jawaban.
Martin sempat menyebut "life drawing", tapi kalimatnya berlanjut dengan "but I think I'd rather…", jadi pilihan itu ditolak. Kata "beginners" sudah tercetak di formulir, jadi cukup tulis "pottery".

questions.evidence: Put me down for Thursday, then.
questions.explain: Jebakan koreksi: Martin minta "Tuesday", tapi kelas Selasa sudah penuh ("filled up this morning"). Ia akhirnya setuju "Thursday". Tulis informasi terakhir yang disepakati, bukan yang pertama disebut.

Ada tiga angka: 70 (biaya kursus saja), 15 (tanah liat dan glasir), dan 85. Label "Total cost … (including materials)" berarti jumlah keduanya, dan resepsionis menegaskan "eighty-five pounds in total". Simbol £ sudah tercetak, jadi tulis angkanya saja.

questions.evidence: The only thing you need to bring is a small towel
questions.explain: "Tools" dan "aprons" disebut, tapi keduanya disediakan oleh pusat seni, jadi bukan jawaban. Yang harus dibawa: "a small towel". Formulir memakai "a", jadi jawabannya tunggal: towel, bukan towels.

questions.evidence: The best place is the car park behind the swimming pool.
questions.explain: Tiga tempat parkir disebut. Parkiran milik pusat seni sedang ditutup, dan yang di seberang "library" tetap berbayar sepanjang malam ("charges all evening"). Kata "behind" di formulir cocok dengan "the car park behind the swimming pool".
